label: Orbit Swap
css: #dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"]{background:radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 50%,#2a1830,#120c14 70%)}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;container-type:size}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-ring{position:absolute;inset:0;animation:orbit-spin 48s linear infinite}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .dyn-card{position:absolute;margin:0;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);outline:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);transition:opacity .28s ease}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .dyn-card.is-swap{opacity:.15}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .dyn-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-chrome{position:absolute;z-index:5;width:min(12%,140px);aspect-ratio:1;pointer-events:none}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-logo{top:3.2%;left:3.2%}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-qr{top:3.2%;right:3.2%}#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-chrome img,#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-chrome canvas,#dyn-mosaic-theme[data-theme="mosaic-orbit-swap"] .orbit-chrome svg{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}@keyframes orbit-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
